hypothesis: Before learning a frequency-dependent trial representation, test whether phase-corrected snapshot bases plus known wave physics can support target-free frequency queries in heterogeneous media.
information_change: Known medium, source and discretized PDE are explicitly available to all methods; this is NOT the old unknown-system sparse-prompt protocol.
prior_art: Inspired by phase-preconditioned model reduction (Druskin et al. 2018); minimal straight-ray control, not a faithful implementation of full PPRKS or a new method claim.
gate: Development raw complex error <=0.05 preferred; retain residual/error discrepancies and failures; target solutions only used for evaluation
